parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The ID of the incremental migration job.

parameters.name: SyncData
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to migrate full data for the last time. Valid Values:

*   true: migrates full data for the last time.
*   false: does not migrate full data for the last time.

Default value: false.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc cut-over-replication-job --job-id j-bp1fnx5y3djc4cop0000 --sync-data false --region cn-hangzhou
